blocks.text: GREENBURGH, New York — The championship celebrations lasted all summer and spread throughout their city, with Knicks being treated to ovations when they were spotted at restaurants or sporting events in New York. Or sometimes even on other continents. “Me and my wife for our honeymoon went to East Africa, we went to Nairobi, we went to Kenya, we went to Tanzania, and it was crazy just to even be out in the Serengeti and the people on the cars, in the open cars, in the wild, go, ‘Knicks in 5!’,” Karl-Anthony Towns said. “That was pretty crazy, actually.” READ: NBA: […]...
